purpose: Validate the executable original CrossRef stage separately after fallback endpoints produced rate-limit responses in A3. Supplemental component baseline, not the full multi-source algorithm.
entrypoint: checkReference(raw_reference) from the same unmodified upstream commit
rows: All 104 references in original file order; no selection by outcome
input: Only original reference string; no manual labels, stored checker flags, or inferred metadata
binary_rule: flagged = not(result.exists and result.matchConfidence > 80), directly following upstream Verified badge
controls: full fallback cascade on jointly complete rows
network: Public endpoints only; no API key, login, model inference or credentials
retry_policy: No automatic retries; errors cached and disclosed; reruns use recorded responses
rate_limit: Sequential references, 1200 milliseconds between references; upstream fallback requests within each reference
missing_data: Mark a row transport_incomplete if any request fails except HTTP 404. Report coverage and metrics only for complete rows; missing requests are not evidence of invalid references. Preserve raw upstream output separately.
metrics: historical-output agreement on jointly complete rows
validation: baseline runs before supplementary comparison is interpreted
cached recomputation of original upstream algorithm must reproduce output
smoke fixtures validate Verified/Partial/NotFound mapping and missing-response handling
limits: Contemporary API state and upstream code differ from the source study
No equivalence to original tool execution conditions
Post-audit addition, not preregistered primary experiment
The CrossRef stage is a component baseline, not a reproduction of the complete CheckIfExist cascade
reason: Some fallback APIs returned HTTP429, HTTP400 or HTML challenges. Restricting this separate baseline to the original CrossRef stage gives an inspectable accessible baseline. Selection of this condition follows observed availability failures; do not describe it as preregistered.
